description: If \(a\ne b\) in \(M\), then \(c_a\ne c_b\) belongs to the signed atomic diagram of \(M\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.Diagrams.signedDiagram_name_ne.{u, v, w} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {M : Type w} [L.Structure M]
  (a b : M) (hab : a ≠ b) :
  ((L.con a).term.equal (L.con b).term).not ∈ Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.Diagrams.signedDiagram L M
